SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-04: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.column.collection, ViewDefinition.select.column.type, ViewDefinition.select.column.tag. Test these items: collection default false when unset, error when multiple values are produced for a non-collection column, collection true multi-value output representation, type URI handling for primitive and non-primitive result expectations, type mismatch reporting for generated/executed columns, tag 0..* parsing with required tag.name and tag.value, database/implementation type-hint tags do not affect base semantics unless explicitly handled. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2 ViewDefinition.select.column / column.tag (models.fsh); reference validator schema legacy-tests/tests.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false on column and tag objects
issues.evidence: parse_view_definition({'resource':'Patient','name':'v','select':[{'column':[{'name':'g','path':'gender','unknownColField':1}]}]}) succeeds; tag objects with extra keys (e.g. {'name':'ansi/type','value':'DATE','extraKey':'x'}) accepted silently. Reference validator rejects unknown properties; parser already rejects the plural 'tags' key, so unknown-key leniency is internally inconsistent.
issues.root_cause: parser._parse_column had no unknown-field check (only the targeted plural 'tags' guard); ColumnTag.from_dict ignored extra keys
issues.resolution: Added _COLUMN_FIELDS allowlist check in parser._parse_column and unknown-key rejection in ColumnTag.from_dict (types.py). Tests: test_parser.py TestColumnUnknownFields.

issues.spec_citation: ViewDefinition.select.column.type: relative URIs implicitly prefixed; element-ID notation allowed; 'Implementations should report an error if the returned type does not match the type set here.'
issues.evidence: Patient view with column {'path':'gender','type':'Observation.referenceRange'} (declared type's leading resource segment != view resource 'Patient') executes successfully and emits '["male"]' on both native and fallback engines — statically impossible type match never reported. Reproducer: .temp/qa/probe.py elemid-on-prim case.
issues.root_cause: _runtime_guard_condition deliberately skips type probes for element-ID declarations (type().name cannot identify backbone shapes portably), so statically impossible declarations (leading resource != ViewDefinition.resource) were never reported
issues.resolution: Added SQLGenerator._validate_element_id_column_types: element-ID column.type whose leading segment differs from ViewDefinition.resource raises ValidationError at generation. Tests: test_parser.py TestElementIdColumnTypeValidation.
